what: drift-baseline.env on-disk key names not specified
scenario_or_breakage: Plan says write drift-baseline.env after PLAN_LINES/DIFF_LINES are populated but check-plan-size.sh reads BASELINE_PLAN_LINES and BASELINE_DIFF_LINES from that file; an implementer may write PLAN_LINES=/DIFF_LINES= keys and drift silently never fires (baseline-absent graceful path)
